scope: Existing kingroon/pla-plus shades without numeric color; no new colors or lines added.
reference_origin: Layer Lookup; site credits Open Filament Database and SpoolmanDB. Its manufacturer-code label was not independently verified against a primary manufacturer palette.
acceptance: Only records explicitly named 'Plus (+) <shade>' were mapped, preserving the PLA+ product identity. All are third-party display approximations and intentionally hidden from the strict curated preview.
rejection_notes: Other generic Kingroon PLA and PLA Basic swatches cannot be carried into PLA+ without exact family evidence.
Kingroon Matte Rainbow requires a verified multicolor provenance model, not a single base HEX.
Kingroon Matte Brown has conflicting third-party screen estimates and an alias 'Default'; do not infer an exact color from this.
Independent physical-print measurement and viewing conditions are unavailable; do not mark these as measured/manufacturer.
